VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people
VR.summary: Xreal's new $299 a01+ AR glasses launch in the U.S., featuring a 147-inch virtual screen and lightweight design for an accessible big-screen experience.

VR.title: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy Returns The Shooter To Its 2024 Era Later This Month
VR.summary: Combat Waffle Studios announces Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy, restoring the 2024 version of the game for Meta Quest and PC VR later this month.

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple publishes detailed technical specifications for third-party motion controllers for its Vision Pro, enhancing compatibility for developers.

VR.title: Steam Frame Launch Nears as Valve Releases ‘Great on Frame’ Store Page
VR.summary: Valve teases the imminent launch of its Steam Frame standalone headset with a new store page highlighting top games.

VR.title: John Carmack Reminds Microsoft He'll Guarantee $1 Million To Bring Team Beef’s Ports To VR
VR.summary: John Carmack offers a $1 million guarantee to Microsoft to support Team Beef's VR ports of classic id Software games.

VR.title: ‘Tomb Raider’ VR Reportedly Cancelled According to Leaked Images & Video
VR.summary: Leaked images reveal that Vertigo Games was developing a Tomb Raider VR game before its cancellation earlier this year.

AI.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
AI.summary: Apple sues OpenAI, alleging theft of trade secrets by former employees to advance the startup's hardware plans.

AI.title: Google will now tell you if an ad was made with AI
AI.summary: Google introduces a new feature that labels ads made or edited with AI in its ad platforms, enhancing transparency for users.

AI.title: The ChatGPT browser is already dead
AI.summary: OpenAI announces the shutdown of ChatGPT Atlas, its browser feature, less than a year after its launch.

AI.title: Fidji Simo steps down from leading OpenAI’s AGI work due to illness
AI.summary: OpenAI's Fidji Simo steps down from her role as AGI chief due to health issues, transitioning to a part-time advisory position.

AI.title: The fight against AI data centers is just beginning
AI.summary: The battle against AI data centers intensifies as local power concerns rise amid the AI boom.

AI.title: Would you host part of an AI data center in your home?
AI.summary: Sunrun launches a pilot program to distribute AI compute units in homes, incentivizing customers to host parts of AI data centers.

NFL.title: Vinod Khosla-led group agrees to buy the Seahawks for a reported $9.612 billion
NFL.summary: Vinod Khosla leads a group to purchase the Seahawks for a reported $9.612 billion, marking a significant NFL transaction.

NFL.title: Aaron Rodgers can become the fifth quarterback in NFL history with 70,000 passing yards
NFL.summary: Aaron Rodgers aims to become the fifth NFL quarterback to surpass 70,000 passing yards in what he claims will be his final season.

NFL.title: Vinod Khosla's wife, Neeru, will be controlling owner of Seahawks
NFL.summary: Neeru Khosla will become the controlling owner of the Seahawks following the sale, with her son expected to play a key role.

NFL.title: Bears sign third-round TE Sam Roush to complete draft class signings
NFL.summary: The Bears complete their draft class signings by officially signing third-round tight end Sam Roush.

NFL.title: Report: Aaron Donald works out at Rams' facility
NFL.summary: Aaron Donald is spotted working out at the Rams' facility, fueling speculation about a potential unretirement.

NFL.title: Nearly 18,000 more seats will be replaced at Acrisure Stadium
NFL.summary: Acrisure Stadium is set to replace nearly 18,000 more seats, following the replacement of 22,000 seats earlier this year.
